estrus_heat.split: 80/20 grouped by cow; cows in test not used for fitting
estrus_heat.interpretation: High accuracy is driven by class imbalance. The model misses most estrus-positive days at the default 0.5 threshold, so it is not yet suitable for reliable heat alerts.

lameness.split: 80/20 grouped by cow; cows in test not used for fitting
lameness.interpretation: The model predicted every test observation as non-lameness at the default 0.5 threshold. Despite high accuracy and ROC-AUC, it failed to detect any positive cases at this threshold.

methodology.model: RandomForestClassifier with class_weight='balanced_subsample', median imputation, 400 trees
methodology.leakage_controls: Excluded cow IDs, dates, target labels, other event labels, episode IDs, and days-to/since-event columns.
important_limitations: These datasets are daily activity/behaviour summaries, not raw MPU-6050 accelerometer/gyroscope data.
Models trained on these files do not directly accept raw MPU-6050 readings; a sensor-compatible feature pipeline and labelled data collection/retraining are needed.
Results are a baseline evaluation only. Threshold tuning should use validation cows, then be evaluated once on held-out test cows.
Do not describe the predictions as veterinary diagnosis.
